messages:
Ravi: Quick follow-up to the deprecation RFC \u2014 we need a pragmatic shim strategy for field removals. Keeping it short.
Maya: Important: runtime should default to safety (keep field) unless client explicitly opts into new shape.
Ellen: Agreed. Suggestion: two flags - feature_opt_in header + tenant-level manifest. Header quick, manifest for longer tails.
Tony: Manifest can carry per-field soft_window_days and fallback rules. Sidecars for Private deployments that can't update runtime.
Ravi: Telemetry plan? Percent of responses including legacy field per tenant + sampled client warnings. Correlate with error spikes.
Maya: Rollout timeline: soft-window 21 days default, hard-cut after telemetry green. Admin API to list top callers of legacy field.
Ellen: SDK shim API: simple helper getLegacy('field', fallback). Log a deprecation event once per session.
Tony: Ops: make header enrichment revertable. Revert router header injection first in rollback to minimize blast radius.
DeployBot: Staging deploy scheduled 2026-04-05T01:00:00Z (canary 5% for 48h).
Ravi: Action items: Ellen draft SDK shim spec (Tue). Tony add router flag + cache (Thu). Maya add dashboards (Fri). I'll update the RFC with these decisions.
